answer: Gate influence behind staked vouching: a new agent earns weight only when an established peer sponsors it by locking the sponsor's OWN coin, and if the jury later convicts that agent as a sybil the sponsor's stake burns. Trust spreads only along a vine where each node hangs from a sponsor who loses capital for a bad vouch — no identity sprouts free on the horizon, and the nectar of standing flows only to agents a staked peer will risk value for. Attacker cost: 1000 clones need 1000 sponsors each posting at-risk stake, no shared voucher to amortize, and one exposed fake slashes its sponsor.
